terms.name: note
terms.definition: A piece of text with an id.

rules.trigger: the user creates a note with non-empty text
rules.response: shall return the note with the next id, the first being 0

examples:
Feature: Notes
  Rule: R-2
    @R-2 @E-2
    Scenario: A created note gets the next id
      When the user creates a note with text "a"
      Then the note is returned with id 0
